description: Assemble the final single-frame comparison table from the computed values and plot TM-score, groove volume and groove charge for the seven structures
code:
import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()
rows=[
 ("Tim17 yeast (9N84, stendomycin)","crystal",133,1.000,3459,5,3,"D17;D76;E86;D87;E126","reference frame"),
 ("TIMM17A human (AF Q99595)","AlphaFold",136,0.851,3005,6,1,"D15;D16;D77;E87;D88;E127","pLDDT>=60"),
 ("TIMM22 human (AF Q9Y584)","AlphaFold",153,0.781,2989,4,3,"E140;E144;D151;D190","pLDDT>=60"),
 ("TIMMDC1 human (AF Q9NPL8)","AlphaFold",151,0.745,2654,1,3,"D163","residues 80-230"),
 ("TIMM23 human (AF O14925)","AlphaFold",85,0.657,3847,1,3,"E102","pLDDT>=60"),
 ("Tim23 yeast (8E1M)","crystal",135,0.649,2822,0,3,"","structural subunit control"),
 ("OXA1L human (AF Q15070)","AlphaFold",229,0.251,932,1,4,"E278","residues 60-350, pLDDT>=70"),
]
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["structure","source","n_res_scored","TM_to_Tim17","groove_volume_A3",
    "n_acidic_lining","n_basic_lining","acidic_lining","note"])
tab.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"TIMMDC1_cavity_comparison.csv"),index=False)
print(tab.to_string(index=False))

col=["#b2182b","#b2182b","#b2182b","#2166ac","#999999","#999999","#444444"]
lbl=[s.split(" (")[0]+"\n"+s.split("(")[1].rstrip(")") for s in tab.structure]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15.5,5.0))
ax[0].bar(range(len(tab)),tab.TM_to_Tim17,color=col); ax[0].axhline(0.5,ls="--",c="k",lw=0.8)
ax[0].text(6.3,0.53,"TM 0.5",fontsize=7,ha="right")
ax[0].set_ylabel("TM-score to Tim17 (9N84 chain A)")
ax[0].set_title("TIMMDC1 has the PRAT fold, not the YidC/Oxa1 fold",fontsize=9)
ax[1].bar(range(len(tab)),tab.groove_volume_A3,color=col)
ax[1].set_ylabel("free volume at the stendomycin site (A$^3$)")
ax[1].set_title("The lateral groove is reduced, not sealed",fontsize=9)
w=0.38
ax[2].bar(np.arange(len(tab))-w/2,tab.n_acidic_lining,w,color="#b2182b",label="acidic D/E")
ax[2].bar(np.arange(len(tab))+w/2,tab.n_basic_lining,w,color="#2166ac",label="basic R/K")
ax[2].set_ylabel("charged residues lining the groove"); ax[2].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[2].set_title("Acidic lining in Tim17 and TIMM22, absent in TIMMDC1",fontsize=9)
for a in ax:
    a.set_xticks(range(len(tab))); a.set_xticklabels(lbl,rotation=45,ha="right",fontsize=8)
plt.suptitle("All chains superposed into the frame of stendomycin-bound Tim17; groove scored on a 0.8 A grid at the stendomycin site",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nCSV artifacts:",sorted(f for f in os.listdir(OUT) if f.endswith(".csv")))
